summary: Render subsystem object constructor variant with a size hint of 0x20. Delegates base initialization to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain with size 0x20 and flag 2, then installs the vtable pointer off_5ADD2C at offset 0x0 and returns the initialized object. Called by the DirectX texture surface factory.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0x20u, 2) to initialize the base DirectX texture object with a mipmap chain, size hint 0x20 and flag 2.
Install vtable pointer: write the address of off_5ADD2C into the object's first dword at this + 0x0.
Return the fully initialized object pointer this.
